integrity: A mathematical claim with a self-contained proof and executable finite diagnostics; originality assessed against accessed primary literature, with explicitly disclosed priority and supplementary-access risks. No independent assessment or empirical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Weak-import stationary kernel at each fixed group size and mixing weight; double limit takes import to zero first. No predictions for finite importation uniformly over growing groups, full epidemic persistence, or noisy observations. Existing publications give the moment ratio and qualitative Simpson overshoot.
title: A sharp overshoot threshold and log-periodic amplification in two-rate contagion
